title: The Lantern Fish
text: A great fish swims through the dark as if it were water, longer than a ship, pale and blind, its mouth hanging open. A light dangles before it on a long stalk, warm and gold and lovely. It is the only warm thing you have seen in days.

options.label: Follow its light; nothing else down here is warm.

outcomes.text: The light leads you toward its mouth.
It leads you a long way before turning aside, uninterested. You almost miss its glow.

options.label: Douse your lights, let it pass, and pray it cannot smell you.

outcomes.text: Its blind eye passes very close, big as a door.

options.label: The cleverest lures it close with a lamp, then cuts off its light for the House.

outcomes.text: Its light becomes a lantern that never goes out. The fish wants it back very badly.
